name: follow-button
title: Follow Button
description: A small social follow button that flips between a solid Follow pill and an outlined Following pill with a drawn check. Hovering the followed state previews a rose Unfollow before you click.
use: A creator, profile or people list needs one compact follow control with a clear state.
avoid: The action needs a confirmation step; this toggles immediately on one click or tap.
a11y: Strong support: a real button, aria-pressed, a focus-visible ring and a reduced-motion path. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded pill in a creator list. Unfollowed, it is near-black with a plus and 'Follow'; followed, it is white with a thin outline, a check and 'Following'; on hover the followed pill turns pale rose with 'Unfollow'.
behaves: Clicking springs the pill wider as the label rolls and the plus crossfades to a check. Hovering or keyboard-focusing a followed pill crossfades to a rose Unfollow preview, and clicking dips and morphs back.
customise: Set following, defaultFollowing, the three labels, size, disabled and change handler; colours and spring constants live in the source.
weight: light: One button with short spring, fade and stroke animations; idle when untouched.
